author_exposure: graph author saw provisional curation before assignment; final frozen cases and pilot selection were not examined during graph implementation
comparison_limits: partial known-positive judgments; unseen hits unjudged; holdout is a reserved regression set rather than a statistically blind population estimate
interpretation: Partial known-positive comparisons; evaluate paired counts rather than infer population relevance or graph superiority.

final_latency_acceptance.measurement_limits: RPC-only isolated snapshot, sequential policy batches, changing background host load; no causal phase claim.

limits: Stateless HTTP client timings exclude MCP initialization and guarded readback.
First observations are not proof of unloaded model/cold OS cache.
Percentiles require at least 20 successful samples; failures remain counted.
Phase timings use the same hashed RPC identity; nested phases are not additive.
Concurrent lanes include guarded readback between searches; this is bounded client load.
Conversational model time and direct OpenClaw dispatch require separate observations.
